source_asset_proof.method: Independently read all eight exact 1be Git blobs and compare manifest byte sizes/SHA; candidate tree matched. No browser or large data decode.

workflow_review.expected_identity: github.sha exported as EXPECTED_HEAD; exact checkout Git tree exported as EXPECTED_TREE; script checks both and tracked clean tree
workflow_review.budget: 8min job; script150s run with explicit operation/CDP/launch/cleanup/request/event limits
workflow_review.artifact: always upload target/qa/lab-transport-diagnostic; missing files is an error; 7-day retention

protocol_review.original_identity: One real page/context and one CDP Fetch owner. Native browser fetch/Response/Reader/Promise are not replaced or wrapped, and no observer then/catch/finally handlers are attached to native promises.
protocol_review.request_scope: Wildcard Request-stage interception is installed before goto. Only exact loopback GET of eight literal filenames and the fixed initial HTML query are admitted; no credentials/hash/redirect/retry/external route.
protocol_review.response_scope: Original Response-stage HTTP200, exact content length/no encoding, original getResponseBody bytes/SHA, then acknowledged continueResponse({requestId}) with no body/status/header overrides; no route.fetch/fulfill/second fetch/takeResponseBodyAsStream.
protocol_review.correlation: One Request/Response mapping per Network ID, exact filename, eight unique Network/Fetch/server records, loadingFinished, zero failed/blocked/errors, full-body pin then continuation ack order.
protocol_review.server_evidence: Original Buffer bytes only; server finish/close/abort observations remain separate from CDP proof. Final server finish and closed-after-finish required.
protocol_review.guard_lifecycle: Guard and error listeners remain until acknowledged page close; bounded callback drain before/after page/context/browser cleanup; final aggregate requires closed page, no pending callbacks/paused requests/sticky errors.
protocol_review.native_unhandled: Init listener only records unhandledrejection without preventDefault. Runtime.exceptionThrown/pageerror/console/requestfailed/native loadingFailed all preserve diagnostic FAIL; no cancellation allowances.
protocol_review.sandbox: Official chromiumSandbox:true, headless, only enable-automation added; observed CDP argv rejects all eight prior sandbox prohibitions and GPU/web-security weakening flags.
protocol_review.ui_scope: Initial and post-PNG actual ready state, baseline seed1/tick0, 24 matrix rows and four visible SVGs; no full LAB geometry/science gate claim.

fixed_review_finding.finding: Earlier snapshot-only UI verdict could ignore a fatal UI exposed by PNG-triggered rendering.
fixed_review_finding.resolution: Shared ready predicate and final live state, bounded post-PNG ready wait, final aggregate ready/workspace/fatal/layout/run/tick/unhandled assertions. Reviewed exact final bytes; no actual PNG claim.

author_source_controls_qualified.reported: node syntax + eight-asset preflight + whitespace + one positive/five synthetic DOM refusals; browser/network/models/Cargo/CI NOT_RUN
author_source_controls_qualified.reviewer_execution: No author test rerun or browser/model execution

qualifications: This is source approval only for the single coordinator-controlled diagnostic launch. The workflow branch pattern itself permits pushes; one execution is a coordinator constraint, not a deduplicating workflow guarantee.

Response-stage interception waits for the entire original body before continuing and can change delivery timing. Even diagnostic PASS cannot prove the uninstrumented transport cause or remove the prior 1be/600/79 failures.
Exact decoded response body pins and native Network terminal state are different from observing product Reader EOF/signal reasons; those are not claimed.
PNG is an actual capture planned for later independent visual review. Source predicates establish readiness around it, not a source-only pixel PASS.
No trace is requested by this expressly bounded diagnostic design. Timelines/body digests/one PNG need actual independent artifact acceptance.
Nine complete LAB gates, final source HEAD/tree full protected CI, existing regressions and future public delivery acceptance remain mandatory before product acceptance/merge.
